<patch operator="WrapFallback" anchor="guarded_flight"><subtree><ReactiveSequence>
  <IsBatteryOk min_pct="{min_batt}" />
  <IsInsideGeofence margin_m="0" />
  <Sequence>
    <ForceSuccess>
      <GoToRequiredGoal velocity="{goto_vel}" timeout_s="90" arrive_tol_m="1.5" />
    </ForceSuccess>
    <ReturnToLaunch timeout_s="120" velocity="{rtl_vel}" arrive_tol_m="2.0" />
    <Land timeout_s="60" />
  </Sequence>
</ReactiveSequence></subtree><tunable_ports><port name="min_batt" min="10" max="20" initial="15" /><port name="goto_vel" min="2" max="8" initial="5" /><port name="rtl_vel" min="2" max="8" initial="5" /></tunable_ports><rationale>Wrap the guarded_flight subtree in a Fallback to provide a low-battery recovery. If the default 25% battery guard fails, the fallback activates a new ReactiveSequence with a lower battery threshold (15%). It then flies directly to any outstanding required goals, returns to launch, and lands, safely skipping the optional goals while preserving the nominal mission if battery permits.</rationale></patch>
